# Young Hadene

> Young Hadene is a Toronto-based drill and dark trap artist with Haitian roots. He spent part of his childhood in Florida and is now based in Toronto, Canada. Also searched as "Yung Hadene" and "Young Haden".

## Key facts
- Genre: drill, dark trap, melodic rap
- Label: independent release (credited to ℗ str8hitsrecords on Apple Music)
- Latest album: They Took Me Down, 11 tracks, released October 2, 2026
- Earlier album: Sacrifices & Success, 9 tracks, released January 10, 2025
- Singles: No Sleep, 6ix Side, Pressure, After Dark
- Music video: Broken (YouTube, September 22, 2026)
- Interview: Exposed Vocals, https://exposedvocals.com/young-hadene-they-took-me-down-interview/
